component.name: sox-noise
component.summary: Noise generator GUI powered by Sound eXchange (SoX)

description.p: SoX Noise is a GTK application that uses SoX to generate white, pink, or brown noise in real time, as well as provide some filter controls and basic effects.
It provides a simple interface for choosing the noise type and adjusting the controls, and it is extremely light on CPU.

screenshot.caption: Main window with noise selector and filter controls
